criterion_4_binding_routes.evidence_github_unreachable: 0 nodes have tracker_binding=github. Schema rule chain that makes github structurally unreachable for features: (1) allOf[13] at schema line ~1433: tracker_binding=github requires github_publication.mode in [issue, issue_and_projects]. (2) allOf[12] at schema line ~1228: github_publication.mode=issue|issue_and_projects requires artifact_kind in [issue, task] AND confirmation_status=confirmed AND evaluation_status=pass AND implementation_readiness.status=complete. (3) Combined: tracker_binding=github is impossible for any node with artifact_kind=feature because the mode constraint forces artifact_kind to be issue or task. Additionally, domain_findings() in validate-graph-schema.py line 289 enforces that tracker_binding=github cannot have beads_linkage != null (binding_collision check). Falsification proof: synthetic graph with feat-user-dashboard set to tracker_binding=github + mode=issue was rejected with 4 violations: artifact_kind not in [issue,task], confirmation_status != confirmed, evaluation_status != pass, readiness != complete.
